summary: Engineer your own roller coaster and see how its design affects its speed.
outcome: When you’ve earned this badge, you'll have learned about engineering and motion by building and testing a roller coaster.

title: Money Explorer

summary: Find out about what you need or want and learn how to make smart choices with the money you spend!
outcome: When you’ve earned this badge, you will know the difference between what you need and want, and you’ll learn how to make choices about money.

summary: Learn about the many things robots do. Then, work in teams, like engineers, to design a robot that solves an everyday problem.
outcome: When you’ve earned this badge, you'll know about the many things robots can be designed to do.

title: Robotics 2: How Robots Move

summary: Think you might be a good robot? See if you can follow your programmer’s algorithm. Then become a programmer and create algorithms for robots and friends.
outcome: When you’ve earned this badge, you'll know how to create a program that could be run by a robot.

title: Robotics 3: Design a Robot
requirements: 1. Plan your robot | 2. Create a prototype | 3. Get feedback on your robot
summary: Now that you know what robots can do and how they do it, it’s time to design your own! Plan and build a prototype of your robot that solves an everyday problem.
outcome: When you’ve earned this badge, you'll know how to design a robot that solves an everyday problem.
